description: Additive commands building on FEAT-001: /invite (any user, DMs the invitee and shows the ready-gate or invite-resume gate, reusing story.ts's gate handler), other-player read-only /profile and /collection (optional user option; /deck and /card unchanged), owner-gated /admin summary (list all players or inspect one), and a PlayerRepo.all() enumeration method. Depends on FEAT-001's gate ids (story:gate:*), sanitizeDisplay, and liveMessageId being in place.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/story-dm-plan.md (steps 7-12) and context.json FIRST. Confirm FEAT-001 is complete (story:gate:* handling, sanitizeDisplay, liveMessageId).

src/db/repository.ts: add `all(): Player[]` to PlayerRepo (doc: every known player as copies, order unspecified, for admin/inspection). src/db/json-repo.ts: implement as `Object.keys(this.data.players).map(id => this.get(id))` (reuse get()'s normalization). tests/discord-helpers.ts MemoryRepo: implement all() as `[...this.players.values()].map(p => structuredClone(p))`.

src/discord/commands/invite.ts (new): data = slash('invite','Invite someone to meet the stranger').addUserOption(o=>o.setName('user').setDescription('Who to invite').setRequired(true)). NOT owner-gated. execute: reject bots and self (self -> suggest /story) with an ephemeral note; open target DM via target.createDM() using the dm.ts error pattern; load ctx.repo.get(target.id); choose ready-gate (no story) or invite-resume gate (GATE.inviteResumeLine(sanitizeDisplay(interaction.user.displayName))) with buttons story:gate:begin/story:gate:resume + story:gate:decline; send to the target DM; reply to inviter ephemerally (success with <@targetId> and allowedMentions parse [], or closed-DM error); log a 'story_invite' game event { inviterId, targetId, ok }. The gate buttons are handled by storyCommand (do not duplicate the flow).

src/game/player.ts: add `hasPlayed(player: Player): boolean` = true when the player differs from a fresh createPlayer (story !== null OR has cards OR wins/losses>0 OR coins>0). Used to show 'hasn't started yet' for never-played targets.

src/discord/commands/profile.ts: add optional user option; resolve target = getUser('user') ?? interaction.user; if viewing another and !hasPlayed(target player) reply ephemerally 'That player hasn\'t started yet.'; otherwise build the embed from the TARGET's player record using target.displayName/target.displayAvatarURL; keep ephemeral.

src/discord/commands/collection.ts: add optional user option; thread an optional target id through the paging button custom id (collection:<page>:<targetId?>); execute resolves target vs self and the not-started guard; component parses the optional target id from customId and views THAT player read-only (never mutate); self-view keeps collection:<page> (backward compatible). Do NOT touch deck.ts or card.ts.

src/discord/commands/admin.ts (new): data = slash('admin','Owner only: inspect players').addSubcommand(s=>s.setName('summary').setDescription('List all players, or inspect one').addUserOption(o=>o.setName('user').setDescription('Inspect one player'))). execute: isOwner gate (ephemeral refusal otherwise). summary with NO user -> ctx.repo.all() compact lines (identity <@id>, story?.node ?? 'not started', 'owns N cards' where N = owned cardIds present in cardIndex), embed description capped ~3800 with a truncation note or an admin:<page> ◀▶ paging row (follow collection's pattern), ephemeral. summary WITH user -> detailed embed from player.story (node, name, isEye, knowsTribe, nameAttempts list, pack present?, starterClaimed) + generic card count; 'hasn\'t started the story' when no story; ephemeral. Log 'admin_summary' { by, target? }.
src/discord/commands/index.ts: register inviteCommand and adminCommand in the commands array.

tests/invite.test.ts (new): invite a new player (ready-gate sent to the target DM, inviter gets ephemeral success); invite a player with progress (invite-resume line names the sanitized inviter); closed-DM error path; bot/self rejection. Reuse the DM mock + owner mock from dm.test.ts / discord-helpers.ts.

tests/admin.test.ts (new): non-owner refused; summary-all lists seeded players with node + 'owns N cards' (seed via MemoryRepo.save); summary-of-one shows story details and 'hasn\'t started' for a fresh user.
tests/commands-flow.test.ts: extend for /profile and /collection other-player read-only + the not-started message (viewing a never-played user).

tests/commands.test.ts: update the expected command-name list to include 'admin', 'invite' AND the pre-existing 'shop' (this fixes the known shop baseline failure). The integration_types/contexts loop already covers the new slash() commands.
acceptance_criteria: `node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/invite.test.ts tests/admin.test.ts tests/commands-flow.test.ts tests/commands.test.ts` passes.
/invite DMs the target with the correct gate and never pings; closed DMs report back to the inviter; bots/self are rejected.
/profile and /collection show another player's data read-only with a user option and a friendly not-started message; /deck and /card are unchanged.
/admin summary is owner-only, lists all players within Discord limits, and shows per-player story details for a single user; PlayerRepo.all() is implemented in both repos.
verification: node ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run tests/invite.test.ts tests/admin.test.ts tests/commands-flow.test.ts tests/commands.test.ts
findings:
DONE. tsc clean; target files (invite/admin/commands-flow/commands) pass. Full suite: 199 passed, 0 failed — the 2 documented baseline failures (commands.test.ts shop list; commands-flow.test.ts /profile avatar) are now FIXED, no regressions.

NEW COMMANDS (registered in src/discord/commands/index.ts):
- /invite (src/discord/commands/invite.ts): slash('invite','Invite someone to meet the stranger').addUserOption(user, required). NOT owner-gated. Rejects bots and self (self -> suggests /story). Opens target.createDM() via story.ts's resolveDm (closed-DM -> null). Sends ready-gate (no story) or invite-resume gate GATE.inviteResumeLine(sanitizeDisplay(inviter.displayName)) to the TARGET's DM; gate buttons are story:gate:begin / story:gate:resume (+story:gate:decline) handled by storyCommand.component (no duplicated flow). Replies to inviter ephemerally with <@targetId> + allowedMentions {parse:[]}, or the closed-DM error. Logs game 'story_invite' { inviterId, targetId, ok }.
- /admin (src/discord/commands/admin.ts): slash('admin','Owner only: inspect players').addSubcommand('summary').addUserOption('user' optional). isOwner-gated (ephemeral refusal; reuses src/discord/owner.ts, no hard-coded id). summary with NO user -> ctx.repo.all() compact lines '<@id> · <node|not started> · owns N cards', embed desc capped 3800, PAGE_SIZE=20, paging button id admin:<page> (component handler re-checks isOwner, else strips buttons). summary WITH user -> detail embed (Scene/Name/One of The Eyes?/Knows the tribe?/Pack open?/Starter claimed?/Name attempts/Cards) or "hasn't started the story". Logs 'admin_summary' { by, target? }.

REPO: PlayerRepo.all(): Player[] added to the interface (src/db/repository.ts); JsonPlayerRepo.all() = Object.keys(this.data.players).map(id=>this.get(id)); MemoryRepo.all() (tests/discord-helpers.ts) = [...players.values()].map(structuredClone).

PLAYER: src/game/player.ts exports hasPlayed(player): story!==null || cards>0 || wins>0 || losses>0 || coins>0. Used by /profile and /collection to show "That player hasn't started yet.".

OTHER-PLAYER READ-ONLY:
- /profile (src/discord/commands/profile.ts): added optional 'user' option; target = getUser('user') ?? interaction.user; viewingOther && !hasPlayed -> ephemeral "That player hasn't started yet."; otherwise builds embed from TARGET's player record using target.displayName/target.displayAvatarURL. Still ephemeral.
- /collection (src/discord/commands/collection.ts): added optional 'user' option; COLLECTION PAGING CUSTOM ID CHANGED -> `collection:<page>:<targetId>` when viewing another player; self-view keeps `collection:<page>` (backward compatible). component parses optional target id and views THAT player read-only (ctx.repo.get, never mutate). FEAT-003 note: if it touches collection paging ids, account for the optional trailing :<targetId>.
- /deck and /card UNCHANGED (per instructions).

story.ts helpers now EXPORTED for reuse: resolveDm(user: User): Promise<DmChannel|null>, gateMessage(line, yesLabel, yesId, noLabel): StoryMessage, and the DmChannel interface { send(payload: StoryMessage): Promise<{id}> }.

TEST HELPERS (tests/discord-helpers.ts): MemoryRepo.all() added; slashInteraction's user is now built by makeUser(id) with bot:false, displayName 'User <id>', displayAvatarURL(); options now supports getUser(name, required?) (resolves a user id string from the option into a makeUser; required=true throws when absent) and getSubcommand(). For /invite tests, pass the TARGET's dm channel as opts.dm (createDM returns it); opts.dm=null simulates closed DMs.
